items.author: busterhearts-type9.bsky.social
items.context: Honestly, I've already decided to not buy anymore consoles, and there's a hard limit on what games my PC can play. So nowadays, I'm just buying old games that I missed out on or the occasional indie.... And even then I'm mostly just playing the same 10 games most of the time 😕
items.text: Classics are a good use of a PC with limits, they barely ask for anything. And playing the same ten favorites is a hobby of its own.

items.context: I watched a whole playthrough of the 2nd game when recovering from surgery a long time ago. Very funny and very wonky (just look at how Twinsen runs in the DOS version). Never did try the remake though I have it. It does look good though, hoping it captures the original vibe.
items.text: Twinsen's run in the DOS version is half the charm. Wonky in the best way.
